name: retro-game-gather
description: Connect to Retro Game Gather to look up Japanese retro games and manage your wishlist, library, play records and collection goals.

interface.longDescription: Retro Game Gather (RGG) is a collection manager for games released in Japan, from the Famicom era to discontinued platforms such as PS3, 3DS, Wii U and PS Vita. This plugin connects to your RGG account to identify games by title, barcode or model number, introduce them with sourced links, keep your wishlist and library up to date, record play sessions and clears, suggest what to play next from your backlog, and summarize your spending and play time. Tags, owned consoles, collection goals and custom entries are available depending on your RGG plan and the permissions you grant.
defaultPrompt: 所有ゲームを機種別に集計して、コレクションの傾向を教えて。
プレイ予定のゲームを一覧にして、次に遊ぶ候補を一緒に選んで。
スーパーファミコン版のクロノ・トリガーを検索して。
